rows.grounds: relative pronoun compounded with past passive participle
genitive plural qualifying the referents whose measure is discussed
demonstrative compounded with noun denoting dimension
imperative prescribing adoption of the stated measure

items.question: Which measure should be adopted for determining the dimensions of all images?
premises: A measure has already been stated in the preceding instruction.
That stated measure applies to all relevant cases.
An alternative option is presented for adoption.
items.inference: Therefore, the previously stated measure for all may be taken as the applicable standard.
uncertainties: The exact referent of sakalānāṃ depends on the preceding context of image characteristics.
items.plain_english: Or else, let that measure which was stated for all be taken.
